title: Bulk Lighthouse & Core Web Vitals Auditor
description: Audit up to 500 URLs per run with Google Lighthouse running on headless Chrome. No API key needed.

startUrls.title: URLs to audit
startUrls.description: Pages to audit. Add URLs one by one, paste a list, or link a text/CSV file with one URL per line. URLs without http(s):// get https:// added. Duplicates are removed.

sitemapUrls.title: Sitemap URLs (optional)
sitemapUrls.description: XML sitemaps or sitemap indexes to read URLs from (e.g. https://example.com/sitemap.xml). Their URLs are added to the list above, up to the 'Max URLs' limit.

maxUrls.title: Max URLs
maxUrls.description: Stop after this many unique URLs (500 max per run). With device 'Both', each URL is audited twice.

device.title: Device
device.description: Emulated device. 'Both' runs a mobile and a desktop audit for every URL (2 audits per URL).
enumTitles: Mobile (Moto G Power, like PageSpeed Insights)

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Lighthouse categories to run. Fewer categories make audits a little faster. 'Agentic browsing' is a new, experimental Lighthouse 13 category.

throttling.title: Throttling preset
throttling.description: Network and CPU conditions simulated by Lighthouse. 'Default' matches PageSpeed Insights: slow 4G + 4x CPU slowdown on mobile, fast broadband on desktop. 'None' measures the page as it loads on the server, without simulation (slower to run, less comparable).

fastMode.title: Fast mode
fastMode.description: Skips the 'Reduce unused CSS' audit, the slowest single step in our tests: it took 22.6 s of a 51 s audit of a CSS-heavy page on one core (about 6% faster on average across our 20-audit test). Scores are not affected, because opportunities carry no weight in the performance score. Turn off to include that audit.

concurrency.title: Parallel audits
concurrency.description: How many pages to audit at the same time. 0 = automatic: one audit per CPU core (Apify gives 1 CPU core per 4 GB of memory, so 4 GB = 1 audit at a time, 8 GB = 2). Running more audits than cores makes them compete for CPU, which inflates TBT and LCP. Capped by memory (about 1.9 GB per parallel audit).

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per URL (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Hard limit for one audit. A page that takes longer is stopped and recorded as failed (not charged).

maxRetries.title: Retries per URL
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry an audit that failed for a temporary reason (browser crash, page did not paint). DNS errors, HTTP 4xx/5xx and timeouts are not retried.

saveHtmlReports.title: Save full HTML reports
saveHtmlReports.description: Also save the standard Lighthouse HTML report for every page in the run's key-value store, and put its link in 'reportUrl'.

compareWithPreviousRun.title: Compare with previous run
compareWithPreviousRun.description: Keep the latest scores per URL and device in a named key-value store in your account and add '...Delta' fields (e.g. performanceScoreDelta) that show the change since the last audit. Useful for scheduled monitoring.

historyStoreName.title: History store name
historyStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store used by 'Compare with previous run'. Use different names to keep separate histories (e.g. one per client).

pushSummaryToDataset.title: Add summary row to dataset
pushSummaryToDataset.description: The run summary (averages, worst pages, most common issues) is always saved as the key-value store record SUMMARY. Turn this on to also append it as the last dataset item (type: 'summary').
